A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:  # Fingers along long axis
        candidate = c
        break

# Adjust grasp height to be at the top of the pen
grasp_height = pen["height"]
grasp(candidate | {"height": grasp_height})

if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

# Rotate to align object's long axis with target orientation
delta = target_yaw - pen["long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=None)
rotate_by(delta)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")

- After the program yellow_pen is offset [-0.0071, 0.2577] m from the centre of green_case ([0.1306, 0.2222] m along / across the zone's long axis) (the zone half size along / across its long axis is [0.0763, 0.0214]); inside_zone=False, resting=True, gripper_holding=False.
